summary: A charming two bedroom mid terraced cottage, ideally situated within a popular village location and offered to the market with no onward chain.
description:
LIVING ROOM A charming and inviting living room featuring a characterful log-burning stove, creating a warm and cosy focal point. A double glazed window overlooks the front of the property, allowing plenty of natural light into the room, with fitted shutters adding a stylish finishing touch.

LIVING ROOM A versatile second reception room offering flexible living space, ideal for use as an additional sitting room, dining room or home office. The room benefits from a double glazed window with fitted shutters.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units, incorporating an electric cooker and sink, together with plumbing for a washing machine. A useful understairs storage cupboard provides additional practical storage, while a UPVC door leads directly out to the rear garden.

BEDROOM

A spacious double bedroom benefiting from fitted wardrobes, providing excellent storage. A window overlooking the front of the property allows plenty of natural light into the room.

BEDROOM A well proportioned second double bedroom situated to the front of the property, benefiting from a front facing window which allows plenty of natural light into the room.

BATHROOM The bathroom is fitted with a corner bath, separate shower, wash hand basin and frosted double glazed window, providing a bright and practical space.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property offers a well proportioned rear yard providing a private and versatile outdoor space, with a useful storage area ideal for keeping garden equipment and household items neatly tucked away. To the front, there is a sizeable garden laid predominantly to lawn, creating an attractive approach to the property, together with a gravelled driveway providing convenient off road parking.
